description: Where a flight is now: finds the aircraft broadcasting the flight number's callsign (the operating airline's ICAO code followed by the number) and returns its latest reported position: latitude, longitude, barometric altitude, ground speed, course, whether it reported being on the ground, its callsign, its ICAO 24-bit address, when it was reported and its age in seconds. The aircraft is named only when exactly one aircraft's latest report (received in the last 15 minutes) carries the callsign; otherwise position is null with a reason (callsign_unknown, not_broadcasting or ambiguous_callsign), never a guess. live is false for a position more than 180 seconds old. Positions are what the aircraft's own transponder broadcast, picked up by ground receivers and relayed to GADUIN with a delay, so reported_at_utc, not the time of the request, is when the aircraft was there; where no receiver hears the aircraft (over oceans and remote land) there is no position for that stretch.

number.description: Flight number: airline IATA or ICAO code plus number, e.g. AA1.

name: get_flight_position
title: Flight position now
